normal.text: Also saw a link to an article how the game proved how “far ahead” Japanese PC tech was and….it’s not that simple? One, the PC98 port came three years after the DOS original and those three years (1989-92) saw a massive leap forward in computer graphics. It was the Age of VGA, ffs!
